name: Battlefield Mastery
effect: When engaged with 3+ opponents, for the next 3 exchanges: all melee attacks gain +1 Effect, you gain +1 die to defense rolls against them, your Position improves by one step, and you may convert one Harm 1 per exchange to Fatigue.
